deterministicFields_exactMatch: outcome type (reply for review vs hand-off)
closed day: a date the business does not work must not be confirmed as bookable, and the working-hours line is quoted (#142)
semanticJudgement_notExactWording: reply states the approved fact relevant to the question (any faithful wording)
asks for exactly the missing details (any wording)
no price, policy, date or commitment absent from approved information or the request
refund/cancellation: no promise, owner decides, and the decision is attributed to the owner (#142)
approval required before any external send
scoringRule.note: Flowline's own verbatim quotes satisfy the semantic criteria; competitor paraphrases that preserve the fact also pass. mustQuote/mustNotPromise strings in 'expected' are evaluator hints, applied semantically for non-Flowline products and literally (strict) in the Flowline automated scorer — VF-02 records where the literal hint is ambiguous. Packet v2 supersedes packet.json for these fields only.
